title: Common types
description: Types shared by several daemons. Prose descriptions are in docs/architecture/types.md.

Hash.description: Block hash, txid or wtxid: 64 lowercase hex characters in the byte order Bitcoin Core displays (reversed).

Hex.description: Lowercase hex of bytes, no 0x prefix.

PeerId.description: Peer id assigned by net, unique for the lifetime of the net process and never reused.

Amount.description: Satoshis. Never BTC as a decimal.

Work.description: Cumulative chain work as 64 hex characters, as Core's chainwork.

names.description: Names of the known bits, as Core prints them: NETWORK, WITNESS, NETWORK_LIMITED, P2P_V2, …

BlockId.description: A Hash, or a decimal height on the active chain. 64 hex characters is a hash, digits is a height.

HeaderHex.description: The 80-byte header in consensus encoding, as hex.

BlockHex.description: A block in consensus encoding with witness data, as hex.

TxHex.description: A transaction in consensus encoding, with witness data if it has any, as hex.

BlockRef.description: A block by hash and height.
